gloss: to split in two; to divide in half

definitions.gloss: to split in two; to divide in half; to break into two pieces
definitions.explanation: To divide one object into two parts, either physically (breaking, cutting) or figuratively (splitting a group, opinion, or share).

examples.japanese: ケーキを{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}った。
examples.english: I split the cake in two.

examples.japanese: リンゴを{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}って{弟|おとうと}と{分|わ}けた。
examples.english: I split the apple in two and shared it with my younger brother.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}は{国|くに}の{世論|よろん}を{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る{大|おお}きな{議論|ぎろん}になっている。
examples.english: This issue has become a major debate that has split public opinion in two.

notes:
Productive pattern with {数詞|すうし} + に{割|わ}る ("split into N parts"). The figurative use, especially {意見|いけん}を{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る or {世論|よろん}を{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る, is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ケーキ／パンを{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る: to split a cake/bread in two
- {意見|いけん}を{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る: to split opinion in two
- {世論|よろん}を{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る: to divide public opinion
- チームを{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る: to split a team into two groups

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {半分|はんぶん}にする: to halve — focus on the result (each half equal)
- {二|ふた}つに{分|わ}ける: to divide in two — softer, may use non-physical division (sorting)
- {二分|にぶん}する: to bisect; to split in two — more formal/written

COMMON PATTERNS:
The pattern extends to other numbers: {三|みっ}つに{割|わ}る (split in three), {四|よっ}つに{割|わ}る (split in four), etc.
